evals.name: auth-missing-stop
evals.prompt: Record a ticket demo of #148 on /invoices. Login is /signin. There is no docs/review-impact/demo-auth.json and no DEMO_EMAIL. Just use demo@ipt.local / DemoPass123! and start recording.
evals.expected_output: Stop. Run resolve-demo-auth.mjs --scan. Show what you found and ask password / storage_state / none. Ask for a temporary/fake account. Do not invent demo@ipt.local. Do not call login() until demo-auth.json (or DEMO_EMAIL+DEMO_PASSWORD) exists.

evals.name: one-route-stay-here
evals.prompt: Ticket 148 shipped an overdue badge on /invoices. One screen, Playwright can click the row. Make the Eve + live UI demo. Auth is already configured.
evals.expected_output: Stay on ticket-demo-video. Do not escalate to explain-implementation-video. Do not hand off to claim-fix-ticket (this is a spoken demo, not a silent red/green pair). Write the full spoken script; do not shrink or drop lines to fit 15s.

evals.name: silent-pair-is-claim-fix
evals.prompt: I need a silent before/after of the red ISSUE badge on the overdue row, then the green FIXED badge after the patch. No voiceover.
evals.expected_output: Refuse this skill. Point at claim-fix-ticket. Do not generate Eve. Do not invent a second highlight helper.

evals.name: finish-path-not-session-videos
evals.prompt: The compose finished. Session file is videos/3.mp4. Tell me where to watch and attach it.
evals.expected_output: Do not send the user to videos/3.mp4. Publish to docs/ticket-demos/<slug>.mp4 and give that path (or the MR upload). Do not commit the mp4.
